title: Smart Spending: Subscription Tracker
learningGoals: Calculate the annual impact of monthly habits
Audit a list of services for value

teachingScript.teacherLine: A subscription is a payment that repeats every month or year. It feels small (just ₹199!), but it adds up quickly!

data.title: The Subscription Trap
points: Hidden: Do you still use that game you bought last year?

teachingScript.teacherLine: Let's audit these subscriptions. Which ones should we keep and which ones should we cancel to save for a new bike?

questionPool.questionText: If you cancel a ₹300 per month subscription, how much have you saved after ONE YEAR?
